answer: Each epoch, every identity must stake on the outcome of random peer audits: it bonds tokens on whether a sampled peer's work will pass review. Correct calls pay a small rebate, wrong calls burn. A farm cannot free-ride, because each alias must risk its own capital on every audit, and siding with a dishonest peer burns the whole row. The cipher of each audit seed is published only after bonding closes, so no falcon-eyed watcher can pre-arrange votes, and influence grows only under the willow of many repeated honest calls.
